home.headline: Find the government schemes you actually qualify for.
home.subhead: SchemeSetu matches your profile against real schemes for SC/ST/OBC, women, and rural micro-entrepreneurs — and shows you exactly why each one matched.
home.feature1Body: Every match shows the exact reasons it qualified — never a black box.
home.feature2Body: Available in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam.
home.feature3Body: See every scheme you've matched, applied to, or been approved for, in one place.
home.heroTagline: Bridge the gap between eligibility, preparation and the official application.
home.trustLine: Government portal at the end — never a fake approval screen.
home.journeyHeading: Everything you need before you hit Apply.
home.journeyDesc: One polished workspace for discovery, readiness and follow-through.
home.matchBody: Profile-based eligibility matching with visible reasons, gaps and verification points.
home.prepareBody: Document checklists, business outline, readiness checks and direct official links.
home.trackBody: Reference IDs, status timeline, notes and notification history in one account.
home.connectBody: Official portal handoff today, with API and webhook architecture for authorized real-time status updates.
home.accessHeading: Built for the way people actually use a public-service app.
home.accessBody: Switch the entire interface between English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam. Use voice input, camera capture and simple guided steps when typing is not the easiest option.
home.readyHeading: Start with your profile. Leave the guesswork behind.
home.footer: Eligibility guidance · official-source handoff · privacy-first account
